title: Not worth the money
text: Not worth the money. These pillows were lumpy, they are nowhere near a “down alternative” except to say I guess that they are an alternative material than down but they’re nothing like it in feeling or quality. These pillows do not hold their shape, they get warm quickly and stay that way, and provide support when on stomach but definitely not something comfortable for side or back sleepers.
